name: Manoah (Samson's father)
title: The Faithful Father from Dan
summary: Manoah was a man from the tribe of Dan who became the father of the judge Samson. He and his wife received a visit from an angel announcing Samson's birth, and they were instructed that the child should be a Nazirite from the womb. Manoah proved to be a godly man who sought the Lord's guidance.

keyEvents.title: The Angel's First Revelation
keyEvents.description: The angel of the Lord appeared to Manoah's wife and told her that she would give birth to a son who would begin to deliver Israel from the Philistines.

keyEvents.title: Manoah's Prayer for Guidance
keyEvents.description: Manoah prayed to the Lord that the angel might return and teach them how to raise the child who was to be born.

keyEvents.title: The Angel's Second Visit
keyEvents.description: God heard Manoah's prayer, and the angel returned and repeated the instructions regarding the Nazirite vow for the coming son.

keyEvents.title: The Offering and the Angel's Ascension
keyEvents.description: Manoah offered a burnt offering to the Lord, and the angel ascended into heaven in the flame from the altar. Then Manoah and his wife realized that they had seen the angel of God.

keyEvents.title: Manoah's Fear of Death
keyEvents.description: Manoah feared they would die because they had seen God, but his wife comforted him by saying that the Lord would not have accepted their offering if He intended to kill them.

keyEvents.title: Samson's Birth
keyEvents.description: The woman gave birth to a son and named him Samson. The boy grew up, and the Lord blessed him.
